top_signals.title: Markets Pushing Limits on Pricing in Fed Hikes, Says  SocGen’s Rajappa
top_signals.summary: Subadra Rajappa, head of research at Societe Generale Americas, expects “a lot more volatility in the very long end” of the yield curve and questions whether the Federal Reserve can deliver on the rate hike expectations of markets. She speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: New LNG Vessel for Diamond Global Energy Named
top_signals.summary: On September 18, NYK held a naming ceremony for a newly built liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier at HD Hyundai Samho Co., Ltd. in the Republic of Korea. The ceremony was attended by distinguished guests and stakeholders, including Tetsuro Wada, CEO of Diamond Global Energy Pte. Ltd.
